what: Readings of the engine repository's atlas/tools/lib.mjs at the commit below, for 21 places at seeded wall times from 1869-12-31 to 1920-01-02 and at minutes around every change of each place's civil clock. Each case is [place, date, time, status, [[utcMs, rule, flag] for each instant], the first 32 hex digits of the SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({ status, instants, skipped }) of the full result]. The site's port of the resolver must reproduce each.
